---
title: "Joint plot with histograms"
description: "Histogram marginals instead of KDE."
date: 2026-01-10
categories: [jointplot]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-jointplot-histogram
#| fig-alt: "Joint plot with histogram marginals"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import soundscapy as sspy

data = pd.read_csv("../../assets/DemoData.csv")

camden = data[data["LocationID"] == "CamdenTown"]

sspy.jointplot(
    camden,
    title="Camden Town",
    marginal_kind="hist",
    diagonal_lines=True,
)
plt.show()
```
